user.title: Aclara ACE water portal
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use on the utility's usage portal (acewebsite.silverblaze.com).

data_description.client_id: Your utility's numeric identifier, found in the portal's login URL (`acewebsite.silverblaze.com/B2C?clientId=NNN`).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the ACE portal
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the portal

init.title: Water tariff
init.description:
Enter one tier per line as `<upper bound in gallons> <price per gallon>`. The last line uses `+` for no upper bound. Bounds are cumulative usage within a billing period and tiers reset at the start of every period.

Example:
```
6000 0.00325
15000 0.00475
+ 0.0065
```

data_description.tiers: Leave empty to skip cost tracking. A single line like `+ 0.005` is a flat rate.
data_description.billing_start_date: Any day a billing period started, e.g. the meter-read date on a bill. Periods repeat every N days from this date, forwards and backwards.

error.invalid_tiers: Could not parse the tiers. Use `<upper> <price>` per line, `+` for the last tier.
error.billing_start_required: A billing start date is needed for more than one tier.
